name: Sharma/Nepal family
summary: Santhosh Nepal (aka Phoshan Sharma) and his wife Aditi Poudel live in Ventura, CA with their daughters Saisha and Savana (Saani). Saisha turns 16 next week and the family is hosting her Sweet 16 celebration on Saturday afternoon, Nov 07 2025, with relatives and friends.

name: Khadaka family
summary: Divas Khadka and his wife Nisha Acharya live in Ventura, CA with their children Aryaman and Mahina. Divas is traveling with Mahina to Kathmandu, Nepal on Nov 18 and returning Dec 08 2025.
